member.name: T:P006BlurBench.Program
member.summary: P0-06 spike harness. Opens 20 test windows (5 per variant: transparent, blur-behind, acrylic, solid fallback) and reports process CPU + working set. The owner runs this in the VM, idles 60 s, drags one window, and records Task Manager / Performance Monitor numbers. Usage: p0-06-blur-bench.exe [transparent|blur|acrylic|solid|all].
